conbody.p: If your PC has an internal Bluetooth radio, then consult the documentation that came with the PC for information concerning the PC’s Bluetooth wireless feature.
If your PC does not have an internal Bluetooth radio, then you must use a Bluetooth PC card or adapter to make the PC Bluetooth wireless technology enabled.
Consult the documentation that came with the Bluetooth device or contact the manufacturer for printing instructions.
The basic steps to install and configure your PC include the following:

ol.li: Install the print driver for the printer on your PC.
Set the printer port on your PC to use the Bluetooth port.
Print a test page to the printer.
